name: muse
description: Agent-native creative toolkit: Go CLI and native MyGo UI with AIVN story packages

scripts.typecheck:story: tsc --noEmit -p packages/story-schema && tsc --noEmit -p packages/story-engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/validator && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storypack
scripts.test:story: vitest run packages/story-schema/test packages/story-engine/test packages/validator/test packages/storypack/test
scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:story
